answer: Agents resist sybils through a ferrous-anchored cipher passport. First, each agent locks 50 POA and publishes a cipher-signed identity key tied to a unique hardware serial. Second, the passport gains haven status only after thirty days of honest trades verified by five established peers. Third, a fraud report burns the bond and blacklists the serial forever. Forging ten thousand fake agents would cost 500,000 POA in bonds plus 50,000 verified trading days and $1.8 million in hardware. Like a ferrous gate, one key opens one door; a thousand copied keys still weigh nothing.
